verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Prompt Playground for working with prompts, models and invocation parameters, tracked via tracing and experiments. Span Replay lets you re-run real LLM invocations with modifications, and you can test prompt variants across datasets of real production examples with different inputs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of template variable/placeholder support in the playground, which supported model providers it calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground workflow.
